annotations.title: Measure whether AI names your site

description: Measure whether AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Google AI Overview, Google AI Mode, Perplexity) name one of your sites, with real answers. Called without approval it returns a preview that runs nothing: the questions, the market, the engines and an approval code. Show the questions to the user and call it again with that approval only after they agree: the measurement then runs in the background for a few minutes and counts as one of the AI measurements your account includes. get_ai_visibility shows the result. Nothing on your site changes.

approval.description: The approval code from the preview, sent only after the user agreed to the questions. Without it, only the preview.

categories.description: The products or services to ask about, like 'running shoes' (3 to 35 characters each). Without it, the categories on the site. Categories saved in Goppa's settings come first.

market.description: Where to ask, as a country code (uk, us, de, fr…) or a region (eu, global). Without it, the market of the site's earlier measurements or the one Goppa detected.

site.description: One of your sites in Goppa, by domain (example.com). Required when the account has more than one site: without it, the answer lists the sites to choose from. With a single site it can be left out.
